prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 51.6 °C (66% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 56.3 °C (56% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 57.7 °C (48% above healthy). Thermal equilibrium is compromised, causing fluid temperature to rise well above nominal operating limits.
Valve: severe lag. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.98 s (within 2% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.58 s (3% above healthy). Substantial delay in circuit pressurization confirms delayed spool actuation in the main valve.
Pump leakage: no leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.57 l/min (within 1% of healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 363 W·min/l (5% below healthy). Pump delivers nominal flow rate at baseline electrical input power.
Accumulator: slightly reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 45.8 bar (within 2% of healthy). Hydraulic dampening shows early wear with mildly heightened ripple during load transitions.
